report:
Support for Azure Database for PostgreSQL - Flexible Server Debezium Connector

Hi Everyone,
We are trying to connect to Azure Database for PostgreSQL - Flexible Server through Debezium Connector Debezium connector for PostgreSQL :: Debezium Documentation
, we followed the document to provide the roles and privilege, but even giving all the roles and access to the newly created debezium_group , we are facing error mentioned below, while setting up the connector in confluent cloud.
The connector keeps on failing with below error message.
ERROR: permission denied for database
I have attached the screenshot for the roles provided to the user with the configuration we are using.

evidence.quote: By default, the connector will create the \"dbz_publication\" as \"ALL TABLES\", which requires SUPERUSER privileges, which your connector user account likely does not have."; reporter: "it worked.

notes: Connector user lacked the privilege needed for the default publication.autocreate.mode=all_tables; PostgresReplicationConnection.initPublication shows the CREATE PUBLICATION FOR ALL TABLES that needs it. Fixed by grants or pre-created publication.

reviews.fix: Gave the connector user the privilege needed to auto-create the ALL TABLES publication, or created the publication manually and set publication.name.
reviews.evidence: Chris Cranford: "dbz_publication" as "ALL TABLES" ... requires SUPERUSER privileges ... either grant that permission to the user or ... create the publication manually"; vivek Kumar: "it worked."
reviews.boundary: B vs C: both suggested fixes change the operator's PostgreSQL (a grant or a manually created publication), so C, but the reporter did not say which fix they used and publication.name is an application setting.

reviews.fix: Give the connector user the privileges needed to create the ALL TABLES publication, or pre-create the publication on the database and set publication.name.
reviews.evidence: Chris Cranford: "requires SUPERUSER privileges ... you can either grant that permission to the user or you can create the publication manually". vivek Kumar: "Thanks for your help it worked."
reviews.boundary: B vs C: default publication autocreate works as documented, but both fixes require a change on the operator-managed PostgreSQL (grant or create publication), so C.
